extraction_notes: The datasheet specifies a P-channel device and prints drain, gate, source, and diode quantities with negative signs. Per the bundled VDMOS archetype, this extraction records magnitudes and polarity = p.
Transfer, on-region, and reverse-transfer-capacitance curves were manually digitized from the typical plots on p. 3-p. 4 using magnitudes.

The electrical table also publishes IDSS, IGSS, forward transconductance, on-state drain current, switching times, and gate charge only indirectly through figures; this extraction schema has no fields for those quantities.
The RDS(on) rows provide minimum and maximum values but no typical column; the maximum value is retained in each schema resistance field.

Units rechecked against Rev. A p. 2 Dynamic table and p. 4 Fig. 6: scalar Ciss/Coss/Crss values 1245/375/210 pF and the capacitance-curve ordinates were transcribed in SI F (pF multiplied by 1e-12); cited VDS = -4 V, VGS = 0 V, f = 1 MHz conditions are retained.
